answer: An identity earns its seat through insurance-backed bond underwritten by a staking pool, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 104 POA of exposure, so 579 aliases carry 60216 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. Hold the kernel up to the light, weigh the ocean of the attack, and keep the ember of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
